title: Release Source Policy
objective: Fail closed before release authority unless an annotated version tag peels to the workflow SHA and its commit is merged into origin/main

oracles: Functional temporary Git repositories cover annotated, lightweight, unmerged, mismatched, and merged-ancestor tag cases
Workflow ratchet tests bind the source-policy environment and full-history checkout

handoff.summary: Release-tag authority now checks full Git history before classification: pushed tag refs must be annotated objects, peel to the exact workflow SHA, and target a commit reachable from a freshly fetched origin/main dedicated ref. Five functional temporary-repository cases, workflow and README ratchets, the release gate, architecture, portable 458/458, strict Python, exact-base changed build plus unit 460/460, and all 220 parallel contracts pass at source commit 4d47036aa9c90d0d80c21cf0912de0c14719fbdf with workspace fingerprint 2c7140a2d15673769fe187195f2c60a915cf81863c8006173f53788bfcbda18f.
risks: This repository-resident check protects the current workflow and operator path but cannot constrain an older or unmerged tag whose historical workflow omits or rewrites it; protected environment review and manual exact-tip verification remain mandatory, with external tag and branch governance as defense in depth.
next_steps: Integrate the source and closure commits onto the exact approved combined release baseline and rerun the affected policy, manifest, portable, and release gates at the integration fingerprint.
Before pushing a protected release tag, re-run the documented clean exact-origin/main-tip operator preflight and have the protected environment reviewer verify the annotated tag target.
